dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the body width from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus, visible primarily along the illuminated right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white baseline on the illuminated right side; the left side is obscured by high-contrast shadows.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-to-moderate density of localized dark-grey markings concentrated on the mid-to-posterior right dorsal quadrant.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse transition between the light-grey primary skin tone and the darker pigmented striations.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Series of parallel, linear dark-grey marks (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the posterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple distinct linear striations or rake marks present on the posterior right flank.
